blocks.title: Profile route responsibilities

blocks.text: Fact corrections accept an intentionally loose value, while output-format corrections accept a named default format. Both can carry an optional reason.

blocks.text: The profile and corrections reads return eo/user_profile results for the authenticated owner.

blocks.text: PUT and DELETE routes handle domains, likes, dislikes, and error patterns. They reject output_prefs because that field uses the dedicated route.
